name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            use-cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            use-cross: true
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-apple-darwin
            use-cross: false
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            bin: azul
            name: azul-aarch64-apple-darwin
            use-cross: false
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            bin: azul.exe
            name: azul-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            use-cross: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.use-cross
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cross

      - name: Build binary
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: true
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.use-cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          fi

      - name: Create archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            7z a ../${{ matrix.name }}.zip ${{ matrix.bin }}
          else
            tar czf ../${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz ${{ matrix.bin }}
          fi
          cd -

      - name: Generate checksums
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            certutil -hashfile ${{ matrix.name }}.zip SHA256 | tail -n 1 > ${{ matrix.name }}.sha256
          else
            shasum -a 256 ${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > ${{ matrix.name }}.sha256
          fi
          cd -

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}
          path: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.name }}.*

  publish:
    name: Publish Release
    needs: release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          gh release create "$TAG" \
            --title "Release $TAG" \
            --generate-notes \
            artifacts/artifacts/**/*

  update-changelog:
    name: Update Changelog
    needs: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Update CHANGELOG.md
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
          
          # Check if CHANGELOG.md exists
          if [ ! -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
            echo "# Changelog" > CHANGELOG.md
            echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
            echo "All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file." >> CHANGELOG.md
            echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
            echo "The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/)," >> CHANGELOG.md
            echo "and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html)." >> CHANGELOG.md
            echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
          fi

          # Create new entry
          NEW_ENTRY="[${TAG}] - ${DATE}

### Added
- Initial release

### Changed
- 

### Fixed
- 

### Security
- 
"

          # Insert new entry after the header
          HEADER=$(head -n 6 CHANGELOG.md)
          REST=$(tail -n +7 CHANGELOG.md)
          
          echo "$HEADER" > CHANGELOG.md
          echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "$NEW_ENTRY" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "$REST" >> CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "docs: update changelog for ${{ github.ref_name }}" || exit 0
          git push
